sentences.en: Hey guys, this is Jay from Boston.

sentences.en: And then I had my Ted and Robin meet cute moment of sorts.

sentences.en: I was in my office, but across the office, even though I swore I was going to be single for a while, I locked eyes with the woman who is now my wife.

sentences.en: I was already a huge Himian fan and always identified with Ted,

sentences.en: somebody who felt deeply and got hurt badly and fell in love fast and wanted to skip the dating stuff to be good at the relationship stuff,

sentences.en: but maybe didn't want to admit that to myself at the time.
sentences.zh: 但当时的我或许并不想承认这一点。

sentences.en: And so my wife and I spent several years after that moment with this really tight knit group, having our adventures around the city, being young, being in our twenties.
sentences.zh: 所以在那之后的好几年里，我和妻子加入了这个非常紧密的圈子，在城市里四处冒险，享受年轻的二十多岁。

sentences.en: And then we had our first child in 2018 and our second a few years later.
sentences.zh: 接着我们在2018年迎来了第一个孩子，几年后又有了第二个。

sentences.en: And this brings me to this underexplored way we watched the show.
sentences.zh: 这就引出了我们观看这部剧的一种未被充分探讨的方式。

sentences.en: There's a phrase you hear about when you become a new parent.
sentences.zh: 当你成为新手父母时，你会听到这样一种说法。

sentences.en: The phrase is loss of identity.
sentences.zh: 这个说法就是身份的丧失。

sentences.en: As a parent, you experience a loss of identity.
sentences.zh: 作为父母，你会经历身份的丧失。

sentences.en: And for all the happiness you feel, all the love and fulfillment you receive,
sentences.zh: 尽管你感受到了所有的快乐、所有的爱与成就感，

sentences.en: you also mourn pieces of yourself that you don't have time or energy to access or that you have to leave behind.
sentences.zh: 但你同时也在悼念那些你不再有时间和精力去触及，或者不得不抛下的部分的自己。

sentences.en: You feel a loss of identity.

sentences.en: And I often think about my days roaming the city with all my friends, daydreaming about the future or just the infinite hours we had at our disposal after brunch on a Saturday.
sentences.zh: 我常常想起当年和所有朋友在城里闲逛的日子，对未来充满遐想，或者只是享受周六早午餐后那任由我们挥霍的无尽时光。

sentences.en: And watching Himian today hits different for me because it gives me access to a version of myself, to a major source of my identity,
sentences.zh: 如今再看《老爸老妈浪漫史》给我的感觉大不相同，因为它让我重新接触到过去的自己，接触到我身份的一个主要来源，

sentences.en: which honestly has been lost as I grew older and became a parent.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，随着我年龄增长并为人父母，这个部分已经丢失了。

sentences.en: And I don't want that version back.

sentences.en: Nothing is better in my life than being a dad to my two wonderful kids, but it helps me feel whole when I watch the show.
